FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: AI Detects Support at MA20 as Fundamentals Turn Bullish
tldr_points: Price holds above the key 20-day moving average, signaling underlying bullish momentum.
RSI at 58.36 indicates room for further upside before entering overbought territory.
Fed officials' hawkish rhetoric contrasts with potential policy shifts, keeping USD demand elevated against the JPY.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY maintains a bullish bias above the 20-day MA, supported by favorable rate differentials and technical momentum.
FX.comment: The pair is trading above its 20-day MA with bullish RSI momentum, favoring long positions on dips.

STOCKS.title: [S&P 500] DOWN: Price Below MA20, RSI 45, and Rising Yields Signal Bearish Bias
tldr_points: S&P 500 trades below its 20‑day moving average with RSI near 45, indicating short‑term bearish momentum.
Rising Treasury yields and Iran‑related geopolitical tension are weighing on risk appetite.
Utility sector weakness adds to downside pressure, suggesting a near‑term correction.
STOCKS.excerpt: S&P 500 under MA20, RSI 45, as yields rise and Iran tensions rise; utilities slip, pointing to near-term downside.
STOCKS.comment: Price below MA20 with RSI 45 and rising yields support a short‑term bearish bias.

CRYPTO.title: [BTC/USD] DOWN: AI Detects Overbought RSI and Profit‑Taking Pressure
